law.catch_line: Filing schedule for candidates for office; November elections

text.section: Any candidate, who was subject to the election year filing schedule set out in subdivisions A 3 through A 9 and who has not filed a final report, shall file reports in any subsequent election year for the same office in accordance with the election year filing schedule set out in subdivisions A 3 through A 9.
Any candidate shall also file any report of certain large contributions required by § 24.2-947.9, if applicable.
